reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, good follow-up to #1922, customrest was the backend still passing a blank answer through as success.

I read the full diff. `GetCompletion` in `pkg/ai/customrest.go` now runs the decoded `response` through `checkCompletionContent` with an empty finish reason, the same call huggingface and gpt2giga make, so a blank or missing field comes back as an "empty completion" error. `TestCustomRestClient_GetCompletion_EmptyResponse` covers both cases against an httptest server.

Build, lint, codecov, DCO, EasyCLA and `validate` all pass at `864ad9f`. Good to merge
